# usio: Async Video Messages and Screen Recording

> usio is an open-source async video messaging platform and Loom alternative. Record your screen and camera in the browser, then share a video link the moment you stop. Viewers can watch, comment and react in the browser.

Website: https://usio.co.uk · Source: https://github.com/robertelding/usio

usio is a fork of Cap (https://github.com/CapSoftware/Cap). Most of the repository is licensed under AGPLv3. The LICENSE file identifies a limited set of camera and screen-capture crates that use MIT.

## Recording

- The browser recorder captures a display, window, browser tab, or camera, with microphone input. It uploads while recording where the browser supports it, and the share link is ready when recording stops.
- Existing video files can be uploaded from the dashboard.
- usio does not currently ship desktop apps.

## Verified Product Surfaces

- Public, private, and password-protected videos with browser playback and embeds.
- Signed-in timestamped comments, replies, and emoji reactions when effective viewer settings allow them.
- Organization roles, members, spaces, folders, branding, viewer settings, and aggregate analytics.
- usio-managed storage, Google Drive for new uploads, and S3-compatible storage. Provider changes do not automatically move existing files.
- Single Loom imports, organization CSV imports up to 500 rows per self-serve batch, and a durable per-video agent import workflow.
- A developer REST API plus recorder and embed SDKs.

Captions, transcripts, titles, summaries, and chapters depend on the recording, processing state, plan, and effective organization settings. Do not promise that every recording has every AI field immediately.

## Teams, Storage, and Migration

- Working with your team: https://usio.co.uk/docs/teams
- Google Drive storage: https://usio.co.uk/docs/teams/google-drive
- Migrating to usio: https://usio.co.uk/docs/migrating-to-cap

Google Drive is a storage provider for new uploads, not a general Drive sync or existing-library importer. A correct migration inventories unique source URLs, maps owner emails and single space names, runs controlled batches, waits for terminal job results, reconciles every failure, and verifies playback, ownership, and location before the source is retired.

## Use usio With an AI Agent

usio can be operated through a shell-capable agent using the `cap` CLI or its MCP server.

- usio for Agents (start here, includes the copyable setup prompt): https://usio.co.uk/agents
- Overview and copyable prompt: https://usio.co.uk/docs/agents
- Setup: https://usio.co.uk/docs/agents/setup
- Workflows: https://usio.co.uk/docs/agents/workflows
- Safety and troubleshooting: https://usio.co.uk/docs/agents/safety
- Installed contract: run `cap guide --json`; do not guess command flags or output schemas.
- Safety: begin read-only, preview the exact change, obtain explicit confirmation before every mutation or paid action, wait for asynchronous jobs, and keep passwords, API keys, storage credentials, and newly issued developer secrets out of chat and MCP.

For Loom imports, `--space` takes one space name rather than a folder path. Without `--wait`, preserve the returned operation ID and use `cap jobs wait <operation-id> --json` before reporting completion.
